answer: Duplicate or spoofed locations are detected by cross-checking coordinates against the atlas registry. Sybil resistance can be grounded in physical attestation: each agent stakes a bond tied to a unique, geotagged hardware anchor installed at a distinct site, such as a terrace, an atlas-mapped wharf, or a warehouse bay. An attacker must acquire and maintain real hardware at many genuine sites, making mass fake identities costlier than honest participation. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
